title: Explainer videos: shoot once, sell in 50 languages
description: An explainer video sells better than a page of text. With AI dubbing you can localize it into 50+ languages in minutes — no studio, no reshoots, your own voice.
excerpt: You've got an explainer that converts? Then why are you showing it to just one language market.
imageAlt: Editing an explainer video on a laptop
content:
A good explainer sells your product in 90 seconds better than a full page of text — that's why nearly every SaaS has one. But most companies shoot it in one language, cutting their reach to a fraction.

## Why explainers work globally

Most of the world doesn't buy in English. A customer who hears the explanation in their own language understands the product faster and trusts it more — and a localized landing page with video converts far better than the English original.

## Dub it, don't reshoot it

Every language used to mean a new studio session, voice actors and extra budget. AI dubbing flips that: upload your finished video and get versions that keep your voice, pacing and intonation — in 50+ languages. No reshoots, no casting.

## The 3-step workflow

1. Upload your finished explainer to [TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io).
2. Pick target languages — start with markets where you already get traffic.
3. Download the versions and ship them to landing pages, YouTube and social.

Bonus: add subtitles to every version — plenty of people watch on mute. And when you push the localized videos to social media, [KupSledujici](https://kupsledujici.cz) helps kickstart the initial reach.

One video shot once, ten markets served. That's math that works.
